rows.grounds: fused compound; genitive dual of pārśva

items.question: Where are the karṇakūṭas measured from on the sides of the alinda?
items.inference: the karṇakūṭas are located relative to the alinda's side-middles
uncertainties: exact architectural referent of karṇakūṭa uncertain
items.plain_english: The karṇakūṭas on the sides of the alinda are measured from their middle region.
